gapReason.reason: The row is the deck's RAILS GENERATORS - the scripts that scaffold a new deck, a new mod, a new set and a new migration. The port is not Rails and has no generator: the port's own deck bootstrap is the seed-and-boot path (src/card/auth/boot-seed.ts) and its mod scaffolding is the mod loader (src/card/mod-loader), so the port binds no generator method. The thirty-one defs the port does not carry are the generator surface: the interactive prompts (run, dev_options?, config_path, bundle_exec, the add_*_option family), the deck generator's file map (databases, banner, core_files, empty_dirs, dotfiles, config, public, spring, script, spec, seed_data), the migration generator (create_migration_file, mod_object, migration_path, migration_type, migration_object, set_local_assigns!) and the mod and set generators (create_mod, root_files, data_dir, create_files). The eight that measure SKIP are the generators' private helpers. The row's own label names the surface: "Rails generators for a new deck, mod, set, migration + the deck templates scaffold".
